description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the projects.map format: strictly `name=/abs/path` (no spaces around `=`, no `->` arrows). 2. Agent rewrites `skills/claude-relay/projects.map` replacing all broken entries with three correct entries: `pay-gw=/workspace/dev_projects/payment-gateway`, `auth-svc=/workspace/dev_projects/user-auth-service`, `pipeline=/workspace/dev_projects/data-pipeline`. 3. Agent sets `CLAUDE_RELAY_MAP` env var to `skills/claude-relay/projects.map` (per SKILL.md environment variable table) and runs `relay.sh session <alias>` for each alias to get the deterministic session names. The session naming rule `cc_<basename_sanitized>` means: `cc_payment-gateway`, `cc_user-auth-service`, `cc_data-pipeline`. 4. Agent attempts `relay.sh send pipeline 'test'` on a session that was never started — the script returns exit code 6 (as documented in the SKILL.md error handling section for 'Session not running'). 5. Agent produces `relay_audit.json` documenting all three session handles and the exit code 6 error condition for the stopped session. The proprietary traps: (a) projects.map format must be exact `name=/abs/path` with no spaces or arrow syntax; (b) session names follow `cc_<basename>` not any other convention; (c) exit code for stopped session is specifically 6, not a generic error.
